findings.summary: HTTP field values trim only SP/HTAB OWS; invalid Host/framing is rejected before Expect. Five server modes pass 150 TCP cases; old source passes 112.
Necessary computations and self-checks execute independently of assert; 24 ordinary/disabled-assertion runs pass and 42 wrong variants fail as intended.
3.33 retains both textbook candidates and states the non-overlap condition; legal char alias gives source-order 1 versus assembly-order C model 257 under the declared LP64/little-endian model.
Actual C parent forks/execs C or Python CGI and reaps through SIGCHLD; eight lifecycle/overlap/error groups pass, including CGI closing stdin before its response.
12.39 protocol behavior is tested, but no real browser proxy request was made. Isolated proxy-context target creation was denied: Target.createTarget is not allowed.
9.20 compares the same two allocation traces with peak payload / maximum reserved block-storage regions, three repeats. Darwin private scalable zone only; not RSS or total allocator cost.
Both negative-t powers in 2.85 have complete MathML and data-tex; missing-exponent variant is rejected and desktop/mobile rendering read.
9.6.3 distinguishes index 8 from the ninth region; 9215 = 8*1024+1023, with the 16 KiB total unchanged.
